text:
Alex: quick async q — clarifying the streaming liveness semantics for chat/completions. If a client holds a stream open but no tokens are produced for >Xs, what do we expect the server to do? reconnect hints?
Mira: good q. current plan: server SHOULD emit periodic keepalive pings (empty delta with event: "keepalive") every 15s when idle, and close after 90s of no activity. that keeps proxies/NATs alive.
Thomas: 15s ping and 90s close sounds fine, but what about backcompat with existing SDKs that rely on immediate close=EOS? any opt-in flag?
Mira: we added optional param `liveness.keepalive_interval_ms` and `liveness.idle_timeout_ms` on the convo request. default behavior unchanged for clients that don't set it (server defaults to no keepalive, old close semantics) — but we should probably flip to safe defaults during canary.
Alex: can you paste the proposed fields? I'll update the spec doc.
Mira: sure:
```
"liveness": {
  "keepalive_interval_ms": 15000, // send empty delta with event: "keepalive"
  "idle_timeout_ms": 90000,       // close stream after this of silence
  "final_eos_on_close": true      // whether to emit final end-of-stream marker
}
```
Lia: question about tool/function-calls: if a toolcall is midstream and connection drops, do we guarantee the tool invocation was executed? we need a clear retry model.
Mira: we decided: tool invocation is best-effort. runtime will attempt once; if client reconnects with the same request_id, server will return `recovery_state: recovered_partial` with the partial tool output (if any). for full guarantees customers should use Dedicated with at-least-once semantics in docs.
Thomas: hmm that `recovery_state` addition seems new. can we use existing `streaming.meta.recovered` instead of inventing a new field? keep schema tidy.
Mira: yes, we can put it under `meta.recovery = "partial" | "full" | "none"`. patch in the API spec now.
Alex: what should clients do when they see a keepalive event? just ignore but reset idle timer?
Mira: yes — treat keepalive as a no-op message that refreshes the idle timer. SDKs should surface it only for debugging.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary to staging 2026-03-18T12:10Z — includes liveness defaults and migration flag.
Lia: thanks. one more: streaming end marker shape. prefer a final delta with `role: system` + `event: eos` or a separate meta message?
Thomas: we standardize on a final meta delta: { "meta": { "event": "eos", "request_id": "..." } } so clients that rely on token sequences can ignore it.
Alex: ok assigning owners — Mira to update openapi + examples, Thomas to update SDKs (js/python), Lia to add recovery tests to integration harness. I'll ping next Thursday for rollout status. :thumbsup:
Mira: noted, I'll open the spec PR and link it here when ready.
Alex: thanks all, this was helpful.
